visual_to_site.objective: Turn a complex concept image into a working responsive website while preserving visual hierarchy, density, and credible product feel.

speed_fleet.objective: Optimize a deliberately bloated website for load/render speed without visual or interaction regressions.

playthrough_debug.objective: Use browser playthroughs to reproduce user-task failures, repair them, and prevent regressions.

generic_bug_hunt.objective: Given arbitrary interactive software, automatically discover controls, exercise click paths, capture screenshots and runtime evidence, then produce reproducible bug candidates and targeted fix hypotheses.

org_builder.objective: Given a target, define and test candidate research/build/verify org layouts, then identify the simplest team configuration on the Pareto frontier.

solo.description: One generalist handles the whole task in one pass.

critic_loop.description: Builder produces, critic finds flaws, builder repairs.

manager_specialist.description: Manager routes narrow tasks to specialists and integrates verifier feedback.

tournament.description: Independent workers propose alternatives; judge selects or merges.

frontier_sweep.description: Many small variants sweep prompt/topology choices; keep Pareto winners.

bug_lab.description: Explorer, runtime sentinel, visual inspector, form fuzzer, reproduction writer, fixer, and regression verifier work as a bug-finding lab.

org_builder.description: Research lead proposes team layouts, protocol builder turns them into ablations, evidence skeptic filters claims, and verifier certifies results.

research_persona_framework.name: Belbin-inspired research team
research_persona_framework.guardrail: Research personas propose and critique; builders implement; verifiers certify.
